comments.author: @vabeach1740
comments.text: I Grated 1/3 of a bar put in large mason jar added hot water melted it put it in a spray bottle. I went outside and started spraying it on ants, spiders, earwigs, flies and they all freaked out fell from table tops and DID NOT LIKE IT. It did not kill anything but everything was running from it. So then I made another batch added 2 tablespoons of alcohol, 2 tablespoons of peppermint oil,50 drops of cinnamon essential oil, then a poured in some cinnamon & clove mouthwash mixtures that I already had made up from my DIY that I love shook it all up went back outside and started spaying any bug I could find and some of them dropped started flipping around (earwigs,big black ants, flies) and some of them died and others were not happy, very spastic moving erratically. I went back out to see if the ants were repelled and half of the places I sprayed the ants were no longer crawling around and in others there were some new ones. I am obsessed now and am determined to find the perfect batch. Thought I would share.
